selection.auditFinding: The canonical timecard backend is missing. Existing hris-time-model.ts and hris-time-workspace.tsx provide only partial legacy UI overlap and do not prove owner API, state, authorization or event conformance.
duplicateAvoidance: BASE-TFR-TIM-006 is a completed G7 slice and must not be reopened.
BASE-TFR-TIM-010 is integrated and must not be reused as the TIM-017 implementation identity.
Legacy UI overlap must be adapted or replaced once; parallel dual read/write paths are forbidden.

purpose.outcome: Consolidate timecard screens into query, correction, submit and decision commands with an immutable decision event.

forbiddenArchitecture: parallel legacy and canonical timecard writers
dual event versions emitted for one decision

migrationDecision.rule: Recheck the post-bridge dwp-dev stream and seal an exact V11 lease in the separate Start Token before creating the file.

acceptanceSummary: Query, correct, submit and decide obey the canonical state machine and expected-version CAS; stale commands have no side effects.
Wrong tenant, purpose, subject, population, field group, closed period or approval scope is denied without disclosing a timecard.
A maker cannot self-approve; delegated and direct-report scopes are re-evaluated at decision time.
Exact command replay returns the original receipt; mismatched replay fails closed and creates no duplicate correction, decision or event.
TimecardDecisionRecorded.v1 is immutable, minimized and emitted exactly once; the unsuffixed recovery alias is not a second runtime event.
The command-receipt query re-evaluates originating scope and returns an opaque result outside that scope.
Targeted backend, V11 migration and frontend tests cover failure, recovery, accessibility and partial legacy-UI transition with no dual read/write.
startTokenGates: Pin clean pushed post-PAY-bridge dwp-dev heads once.
Reseal EVT-TIM:TimecardDecisionRecorded.v1 as the sole canonical runtime identity and map the recovered alias as history only.
Seal Authorization, OpenAPI, Gateway and owner-operation bindings for the five PEPs.
Issue a collision-free V11 migration lease.
Materialize new dedicated TIM backend and frontend worktrees from the issued pins.
Issue a separate Start Token sealing exact paths, no-dual-write rule, worktrees, checks and acceptance IDs.

dispatchInstruction.message: Review this packet, verify the canonical backend gap and classify the two legacy UI files as reusable, replaceable or unrelated. Report event-name, path and migration collisions only. Do not edit source or documentation, create a migration, branch or worktree, run broad suites, commit, push, merge, implement, or introduce dual read/write before a separately issued Wave5 Start Token.
requiredReport: legacy UI overlap disposition without edits
